name: Trailblazer Merger Corporation I
summary: Trailblazer Merger Corporation I is a blank check company (SPAC) formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. SPACs do not have an existing business at the time of their formation. Trailblazer Merger Corporation I is based in the USA.
